AccessProjectionCausalParent.title: AccessProjectionCausalParent
AccessProjectionCausalParent.description: Causal parent of an access-projection event: an earlier event in the same stream (the W010 shape).

AccessStreamId.title: AccessStreamId
AccessStreamId.description: One access-projection event stream id (the W010 grammar): stream:access-<slug>, one object/policy/tenant-state = one stream.

AccessProjectionEventSequence.title: AccessProjectionEventSequence
AccessProjectionEventSequence.description: One access-projection event sequence number: 1-based, contiguous per access-projection stream.
